theses.thesis: The strongest combo of trend, durability, breadth and crowding on the board. Hurst 'trend' (0.8 durability), breadth 0.8 (best among eligible), uncrowded (z 0.32 vs Banks 1.06). Eligible under the absolute-trend gate, so on the one leg with a validated edge it already qualifies.
